title: Indonesia NEK ETS Phase 2 begins
description: ETS expands to captive coal plants (>25 MW) and gas-fired power plants, increasing coverage to 563 installations.

title: Presidential Regulation No. 110/2025 issued
description: Replaces PR 98/2021. Establishes a new national carbon pricing governance framework, introduces the SRUK registry, and formalizes carbon allocation ceilings.

title: Indonesia begins CORSIA participation
description: Indonesia starts participation in the Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA), allowing domestic offsets for aviation compliance.

title: EU CBAM definitive phase begins
description: Financial adjustments now required. Indonesian exporters of steel, cement, aluminum, fertilizers, and hydrogen must surrender CBAM certificates.

title: National Carbon Market Full Operation
description: Target date for the unified national carbon market and registry (SRUK) to be fully operational under the new regulatory framework.

title: Resumption of large-scale carbon trading
description: Active trading and transactions are expected to resume at scale following the alignment with PR 110/2025.

title: ETS expansion to industrial sectors
description: Transition year for expanding the ETS to nine industrial sectors, including cement, steel, pulp and paper, and textiles.

title: First annual EU CBAM declaration due
description: Deadline for the first annual CBAM declaration covering embedded emissions for the 2026 calendar year.

title: Indonesia NEK ETS Phase 3 begins
description: ETS moves toward economy-wide coverage and absolute emission caps aligned with the Second NDC target.
